product.outcome: Choose a small-batch piece, inspect the maker’s terms, and pay once with an order reference that survives an uncertain payment response.

users.who: A buyer comparing small-batch goods and checking delivery from a phone or laptop.

capabilities.note: The invented shop accepts one piece per checkout and returns a durable order reference.
A payment attempt is idempotent and its result can be checked without charging again.
Buyers can save a piece and later revisit its current terms.
Maker messages are persisted before a sent acknowledgement appears.
Shopping preferences persist independently of an order.
A shipping email is sent only after a parcel tracking reference is recorded.
An opted-in buyer is notified when the saved piece’s price changes.
Opening a maker shop is not part of the buyer contract; no seller-registration control is rendered.

shopReady.label: Available pieces
shopReady.rule: Show maker, price and availability on each card; buying begins only after the piece is inspected.

shopLoading.label: Refreshing pieces
shopLoading.rule: Keep the last assortment and the current filters visible while refreshing; do not claim new stock has arrived.

shopEmpty.label: No matching pieces
shopEmpty.rule: Keep the query and selected filters so the buyer can clear them rather than starting an unrelated task.

shopFailed.label: Shop unavailable
shopFailed.rule: Show that the assortment could not be retrieved and retry without changing the buyer’s filters.

shopLongContent.label: Long maker descriptions
shopLongContent.rule: Wrap the print’s complete edition name and material description without hiding its maker or price.

shopSoldOut.label: Sold-out piece
shopSoldOut.rule: Retain the piece’s identity and show Sold out; inspection is available but payment is not.

goodsDetailReady.label: Piece available
goodsDetailReady.rule: Show the selected piece and maker, then the delivery and return terms; Buy opens the final checkout review.

goodsDetailLoading.label: Refreshing piece
goodsDetailLoading.rule: Keep the selected piece visible while checking its current price and stock; withhold Buy until refreshed.

goodsDetailEmpty.label: Piece removed
goodsDetailEmpty.rule: Show that this piece is no longer listed and return to the shop without inventing a replacement.

goodsDetailFailed.label: Piece unavailable
goodsDetailFailed.rule: Explain a retrieval failure, not a card decline; do not offer payment while the maker’s terms cannot be read.

goodsDetailLongContent.label: Long piece details
goodsDetailLongContent.rule: Wrap the complete print edition name and maker’s care description before the buying action.

goodsDetailSoldOut.label: Sold out
goodsDetailSoldOut.rule: Show the sold-out piece and its maker’s terms with no Buy action.

goodsDetailMadeToOrder.label: Made to order
goodsDetailMadeToOrder.rule: Explain that the serving bowl is made to order and that its cancellation window closes when work starts.

goodsDetailSavingPiece.label: Saving piece
goodsDetailSavingPiece.rule: Keep the piece visible and prevent a duplicate save until the saved list accepts it.

goodsDetailPieceSaved.label: Piece saved
goodsDetailPieceSaved.rule: Confirm that the piece is now in Saved and keep its buying terms available.

goodsDetailSaveFailed.label: Save failed
goodsDetailSaveFailed.rule: Keep the piece visible and offer another save without implying a purchase failed.

checkoutEditable.label: Editable
checkoutEditable.rule: Show the reserved piece, delivery form, selected card and exact final total. Paying submits one idempotent payment attempt.

checkoutPaying.label: Paying
checkoutPaying.rule: Keep the reviewed summary and delivery details read-only. Replace Pay with payment progress and prevent a second charge.

checkoutDeclined.label: Card declined
checkoutDeclined.rule: State that the provider rejected payment, retain all delivery values, and let the buyer select another card before trying again.

checkoutUnknown.label: Payment outcome unknown
checkoutUnknown.rule: Retain the attempt reference and total. Never offer Pay again until Check payment status establishes whether this attempt was paid.

checkoutChecking.label: Checking payment
checkoutChecking.rule: Query the existing payment attempt, not a new charge; keep duplicate checking disabled.

checkoutPaid.label: Paid
checkoutPaid.rule: Show the accepted order reference and maker, replace the delivery form and every payment action with a receipt summary and View orders; never offer paying the same order again.

checkoutLongContent.label: Long delivery details
checkoutLongContent.rule: Wrap the full recipient and receiving instructions; keep the total and payment action reachable without truncation.

ordersReady.label: Order history
ordersReady.rule: Show each durable order reference with its maker, payment or parcel status and total.

ordersLoading.label: Refreshing orders
ordersLoading.rule: Keep the known order history visible while retrieving parcel changes.

ordersEmpty.label: No orders yet
ordersEmpty.rule: Explain that purchases appear here after payment; start from the shop rather than creating an empty order.

ordersFailed.label: Order history unavailable
ordersFailed.rule: Explain that order retrieval failed without suggesting a payment failed; retry the history request.

ordersLongContent.label: Long order name
ordersLongContent.rule: Wrap the complete wool throw name beside its parcel reference and maker.

ordersPlaced.label: New order
ordersPlaced.rule: Show the newly accepted mug order as Packing with its payment total and stable order reference.

makerThreadReady.label: Conversation
makerThreadReady.rule: Show the maker’s replies in timestamp order with the mug order beside them.

makerThreadLoading.label: Refreshing messages
makerThreadLoading.rule: Keep the existing conversation and selected order visible while fetching replies.

makerThreadEmpty.label: No messages
makerThreadEmpty.rule: Keep the selected mug order visible and offer to ask its maker the first question.

makerThreadFailed.label: Messages unavailable
makerThreadFailed.rule: Keep the selected order visible but report that the conversation could not be retrieved.

makerThreadLongContent.label: Long maker reply
makerThreadLongContent.rule: Wrap the maker’s complete reply and studio name; keep the composer after the transcript.

makerThreadSending.label: Sending message
makerThreadSending.rule: Keep the authored draft visible and disable duplicate sending until the maker thread accepts it.

makerThreadSent.label: Message sent
makerThreadSent.rule: Append the persisted message in the thread and announce success before clearing the composer.

makerThreadSendFailed.label: Message not sent
makerThreadSendFailed.rule: Keep the unsent draft beside the transcript and offer Send again without reloading the order.

savedReady.label: Saved pieces
savedReady.rule: Show saved pieces with today’s maker and price; opening a piece rechecks its stock before payment.

savedLoading.label: Refreshing saved pieces
savedLoading.rule: Keep the saved list visible while checking current prices.

savedEmpty.label: No saved pieces
savedEmpty.rule: Explain that Save piece on a detail page builds this list.

savedFailed.label: Saved pieces unavailable
savedFailed.rule: Retry loading the saved list without claiming the buyer’s saves were removed.

savedLongContent.label: Long saved piece name
savedLongContent.rule: Wrap the saved print’s edition name and keep its maker and current price visible.

settingsReady.label: Editable
settingsReady.rule: Keep the saved delivery-email, gift-wrap-prompt and price-alert preferences beside their controls; changes apply only after Save preferences.

settingsSaving.label: Saving
settingsSaving.rule: Keep changed preferences visible, disable Save, and announce the in-flight persistence operation.

settingsSaved.label: Saved
settingsSaved.rule: Show the persisted preference values and an inline acknowledgement without leaving settings.

settingsFailed.label: Save failed
settingsFailed.rule: Retain unsaved shopping preferences and explain that the previous saved preferences still apply; another explicit Save preferences is safe.

helpReady.label: Shipping and returns
helpReady.rule: Explain separate maker parcels and the return or cancellation windows without claiming the buyer has started a return.

landingReady.label: Buyer introduction
landingReady.rule: Explain buying from independent makers and link only to the shop, saved pieces, shipping help and messages; do not offer unsupported seller registration.

emailOrderShippedReady.label: Parcel shipped
emailOrderShippedReady.rule: Send this message only when the wool throw order is Shipped and has a tracking reference; its action opens that order’s parcel details.

pushPriceChangedReady.label: Saved price changed
pushPriceChangedReady.rule: Notify only an opted-in buyer about the saved mug’s current price; opening the piece does not automatically place an order.

flows.goal: Compare available pieces and inspect one maker’s materials and terms.
flows.ends: The chosen piece’s price, availability, maker, materials and return terms are visible before any payment.

binding.because: The buying decision starts in the same assortment composition as the shop.

flows.goal: Pay once for the inspected piece and keep the accepted order reference.
flows.ends: Payment is confirmed once, the mug order is Packing with reference #4183, and the buyer can revisit it without paying again.

binding.because: One maker’s piece, one delivery choice and an exact final total fit a single review page.

flows.goal: Ask the maker about glaze, care or delivery and keep the reply attached to the order.
flows.ends: The persisted reply appears in the mug’s maker conversation and the unsent draft is cleared only after acceptance.

flows.goal: Save a piece and revisit its current maker and price.
flows.ends: The saved piece remains in the buyer’s list and its current stock and price are rechecked on opening.

flows.goal: Choose delivery emails, gift-wrap prompts and saved-price alerts.
flows.ends: The saved settings apply to later shopping without changing an order already paid.

flows.goal: Understand separate parcels and return windows before contacting a maker.
flows.ends: The buyer can distinguish a 30-day return from a made-to-order cancellation before work starts.

flows.goal: Understand buying from a maker and enter the shop.
flows.ends: The buyer reaches the assortment without entering an email address or an unsupported seller-registration flow.

flows.goal: Open parcel tracking from a shipping email.
flows.ends: The shipped order and its existing parcel reference are visible; the message does not imply a second order.

flows.goal: Inspect a saved piece after its price changes.
flows.ends: The current price is visible before the buyer chooses whether to enter checkout.

surfaces.question: Which maker’s piece fits my materials, price and availability needs?

slots.because: Material categories and stock availability can be combined before refreshing the assortment.

binding.because: Glaze, weave and shape make images useful before reading the maker’s full description.

surfaces.question: What is this piece made from, can it be bought now, and what are the maker’s shipping and return terms?

slots.because: The buyer reviews which maker and piece will enter checkout before leaving the detail page.

surfaces.question: Are the piece, delivery address, selected card and total correct, and has this payment actually been accepted?

binding.because: One piece, one maker and one delivery choice can be reviewed together; payment never edits the goods catalog.

surfaces.question: Which orders are paid, where is each parcel, and which maker should I contact about delivery?
What did this piece’s maker say about glaze, care or delivery, and has my reply been sent?

binding.because: The mug’s order reference and maker must remain visible while discussing glazing and delivery.

surfaces.question: Which pieces did I save, and what do their makers charge now?
Do I want delivery emails, gift-wrap prompts and price alerts for my saved pieces?

binding.because: Delivery emails, gift-wrap prompts and saved-price alerts are a small set of buyer preferences with one explicit save.

surfaces.question: How do separate maker parcels, returns and made-to-order cancellations work?
Why buy directly from an independent maker, and where can I inspect the pieces and delivery rules?
Which maker shipped my piece, and where can I track this parcel?
What is the saved piece’s new price, and can I inspect it before deciding to buy?
